correctness.rationale: Use the exact eligibility s+ℓ≤i. Base-three digits give c(n)=1 precisely for digits 0 and 2; at scale q=3^(j−1), aligned blocks are C_(j−1) or all zero, and the former begin and end in 1. The first five phrases reach 8. At 8q the source at 2q supplies 4q characters, and extension would require a zero run longer than the largest preceding run of 3q. At 12q the maximal zero match is 3q, witnessed by the source at 9q which ends exactly at the head. At 15q the nine-block match is witnessed at 3q. An extension would have to copy the internal C_j of length 3q at source offset 3q: both endpoints must be 1, so this C_j starts at 0 or 6q in the earlier prefix. The two one-bearing triples are too far apart to allow crossing, and within either triple a length-3q occurrence must use both extremes. The only nonnegative candidate source is thus 3q, and its next symbol at 12q is 0 whereas the target next symbol at 24q is 1. This proves maximality including q=1. Since 24q is 8 times the next scale, the triples exhaust the infinite parse. Cutting at 3^k retains the same eligible sources until the last head and leaves exactly 3^(k−2) symbols there for k≥2; the transmitted phrase is truncated, giving 5+3(k−2)+1=3k. The exact k=0,1 cases are direct. A separately written source scan reproduced every finite pair through k=7 (15 full triples over the tested parses) and checked the three source witnesses. The supplied checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Finite replay is diagnostic; the aligned source and maximality arguments establish all scales.

value.rationale: The binary Cantor word is a standard nonperiodic uniform morphic input with a natural scale sequence. A complete nonoverlap parse resolves the exact constant hidden in generic logarithmic growth, displays the mechanism of its scale recurrence, and gives explicit inputs and expected phrase boundaries for comparing parsers that otherwise have the same asymptotic rate. This is an all-level structural classification, not a chosen finite example.
residual_risks: No exact formula for other parsing conventions or arbitrary finite prefix lengths is claimed.
